title: 第5章 危急第6章 坠落第7章 遇难之后
content_zh:
第五章 危急
风蛇群原本猛烈的攻势缓了一缓，而原本混乱，充斥着怒喝，呼喊，尖叫声的甲板上，居然出现了那么一瞬间的寂静。所有人都拿着不可思议的眼神望着那个年轻男子，完全不知道该说什么才好。
就在刚才那一刻，几乎每个人都认为这个年轻人死定了，他们从来没有见过哪个人能够在数十条风蛇的围攻下全身而退的。当然，那些高阶职业者，或者是全身盔甲的盾战士说不定可以做到这一点。但是这个年轻人看起来年纪并不大，而且他全身上下除了手中所握的那把白色长剑之外可没有任何防护装备。
但是他居然做到了。
这一刻，不仅仅是那些佣兵，甚至连莉洁和卡特都不由有些呆滞的望着那个年轻人，内心起伏不定。
他究竟是何方神圣？
不知道是不是因为被罗德的攻击所慑，那些原本还在拼命攻击浮空船的风蛇全部都散开退了下去，一时间，整个甲板上除了呼啸的风声之外，几乎安静的什么都听不见。佣兵们是为罗德的表现而感到震惊，不过对于罗德来说，他倒并没有在乎自己做了什么，相反，此刻他望着眼前脚下那一堆尸体，心中也是暗叫好险。
虽然风蛇作为最低级的怪物之一，本身实力并不算特别强悍，但是毕竟也算是靠数量取胜的怪物。罗德的召唤剑士属于单刷职业，但是大范围的单刷却并不给力，事实上这次之所以能够这么顺利，主要还是因为他手上的“星痕”初始+3的特性，这意味着在持有这把剑时，罗德的属性可以向上提高三点，这三点的提升就足以使一个怪物的危险等级从红色降到绿色，因此对于罗德来说，消灭这群风蛇倒也不算特别让人惊讶的事情。
不过想到这里，罗德还是有些奇怪，按照自己如果是人类的属性来计算的话，那么哪怕是持有“星痕”，也不应该这么秋风扫落叶，获得这种压倒性的优势才对，按照他原本的估计，破碎之刃最多也就是把这群风蛇扫个残血，因此他也早就做好了上去补刀的准备。但是没有想到这一招破碎之刃的威力居然远远超乎自己的想象，居然直接把这群风蛇给扫死了？
难道自己的属性不是按照人类来计算的？
想到这里，罗德又下意识的去调出自己的属性表，不过无奈的是，在他的种族尚未查明之前，他的属性也是隐藏的，无法查询。不过幸运的是，这次的战斗让他拿到了1900点经验值———居然真的有经验值可拿，这点让罗德还是相当惊讶。
当然，这对于罗德来说也只是两三秒的工夫，在旁人看来他只是盯着脚下那堆尸体沉默片刻，随后又再次抬起头来。
而就在这时，罗德才发现四周古怪的寂静，那并不是因为其他人的震惊，而是某种更加危险，致命的存在。
风蛇群呢？
这个念头在罗德的脑中一闪而过，随后他似乎想起了什么，急忙转过身，开口大喊。
“所有人小心………！”
而就在这时，浮空船猛然一震。
剧烈的震动使得不少人直接摔倒在地，甚至还有两个倒霉鬼没有来得及站稳，直接失足滑落，掉了下去。而与此同时，船头的甲板发出了清脆的破裂声，紧接着，一个巨大的蛇头从中探了出来。
“大家小心，是风蛇领主！”
这时卡特终于出现，他大喝一声，接着抽出手边的双剑，向着这头巨大的风蛇飞奔过去。而其他的佣兵此刻也急忙站起身来，虽然他们已经伤痕累累，但是他们依旧咬紧牙关，跟随着自己的团长，试图对这个庞然大物发起攻击。

不过，罗德的动作却比他们都快。
他半蹲下身体，一行行系统提示立刻出现在他的眼前。
[经验点数1900/200，可升级，获得技能点数1，等级2]
[经验点数1700/400，可升级，获得技能点数2，等级3]
[经验点数1300/600，获得技能点数3，等级4]
[经验点数800/1000，获得技能点数4，等级5]
[消耗1点技能，提升月影剑术1/3，熟练度E]
[消耗1点技能，提升月影剑术2/3，熟练度E]
[消耗1点技能，提升月影剑术3/3，熟练度E]
[消耗1点技能，提升月影剑术1/4，熟练度D———影闪解锁]
罗德纵身而起。
在那瞬间，众人只感觉眼前一花，随后便看见原本站在地面上的年轻男子化为了一道黑色的阴影，宛如利刃般划破天空直冲上前，甚至连巨大的风蛇领主都没有来得及反应，当罗德飞跃而起，来到它的面前时，对方甚至还显的有些疑惑———很明显它也从来没有遇到过猎物主动跳起来送到自己嘴边的诡异情况。
罗德举起长剑，星尘的光辉在那一瞬间仿佛被无形的引力所吸引般凝结在了洁白无暇的剑身之上，随后他对准风蛇领主那如铜铃般大小的眼睛，用力刺下。
“破碎之刃！”
面对迎面扑来的剑光，风蛇之主的第一个反应就是躲避，在将月影剑术连续提升了四个熟练度之后，破碎之刃无论数量还是威力上都猛然提升了不止一个台阶，数十道银白的光刃在那一瞬间从剑身上暴发，盘旋着激射向前方。
一道，两道，三道………
一开始的时候，风蛇领主那坚硬的鳞片还勉强抵挡住了最开始的剑光之刃，但是即便以他领主级别的防护，也仅仅只坚持到第二十道剑芒便彻底崩溃。随后而来的剑光轻而易举的撕裂鳞片与血肉，刺穿了它的身体。虽然风蛇领主身躯庞大，但是罗德非常聪明的选择了一点突破，在他的掌控下，光刃并没有象之前那样散开，而是集中射向了对方的脖颈部分，并且成功的突破了对方的防御。
“———！！”
风蛇领主发出了一声尖锐的嘶鸣，随后便重重的向下落去，但是即便如此，它也没有放弃攻击的意思，虽然左颈部分已经变的血肉模糊，但是夜鸦之主还是猛然抬起头来，死死的盯着罗德，随后猛然张开了大嘴。
罗德身影一晃，再一次化为一道幻影急撤向后，而就在他撤退开来的同时，腥臭无比的毒液直射而上，堪堪擦过罗德的残象，喷到了后方的桅杆上，很快，在那毒液的腐蚀下，原本粗壮坚硬的桅杆仅仅只是几秒钟的工夫，便彻底融化，随后轰然倒塌。

BOSS毕竟是BOSS。
根据罗德在游戏中的经验，风蛇的平均等级在三级左右，而其首领一般在十级，眼前的这只BOSS最多应该不超过十级。虽然在等级上，借助卡特和佣兵的掩护，打败这只BOSS并不困难，但是从刚才那一剑之后，罗德就察觉出这恐怕并不是普通的领主级怪物，而是精英，毕竟如果只是普通的领主怪物，那么罗德刚才那一剑足以砍下它的翅膀。但事实上虽然罗德拼尽全力，却依旧只给它留下了一道深可见骨的伤痕，这就已经非常说明问题所在了。
“去攻击它的翅膀，注意尽量远离它的嘴巴！到它的身侧进行攻击！”
罗德一面指挥着卡特和其他的佣兵，一面与风蛇领主纠缠着，虽然作为一名召唤剑士，他并不是做MT的主力，但是看样子其他人似乎都没有和风蛇领主交过手进行过战斗的经验，在游戏中因为经验不足团灭了还可以重来，但是在这里罗德可不愿意冒这个险———之前左胸原本愈合的伤口现在火辣辣的疼痛，似乎又裂开了。要是万一在这里因为团灭死掉，那么可就是个哭都哭不出来的笑话。而且虽然他现在也不过才5级，但是对于罗德来说，只要对方级别不超过15级以上，那么他都有信心一战。毕竟在龙魂大陆中，有三个职业都是以越级刷怪闻名，法师，游侠，最后一个就是召唤剑士。法师以变幻莫测的法术闻名，游侠则是以超远距离的“放风筝”而得力，至于召唤剑士则根本就是以多打少——对于这三个职业来说，哪怕等级差超越五级对于他们来说都是象吃饭喝水般轻松容易，一直到十级差为止的非精英BOSS级存在都可以刷的随心所欲。
虽然如此，但是这三个职业也都是各有缺陷——法师没了魔力就和靶子没区别，哪怕是一群低级妖精都可以把其围殴到死，游侠被人近身就是彻底悲剧，召唤剑士随机性太大，操作复杂到近乎没有模板可依。这也是为什么这三个职业在游戏中并没有到达风起云涌地步的原因。而这也是更接近龙魂大陆的现实设定———要么赌一把不走寻常路，要么安稳的缓步前行，玩家可以随意决定自己的命运与未来。
眼下的风蛇领主是十级的精英BOSS，不过因为自己手中所持有的星痕加成，它的防御力最多也不过六七级的水准，所以在防御上，罗德倒是不用担心伤害不足，但是在攻击方面…………
“呼！！”
猛烈的风声平地而起。
罗德身形猛然一晃，夹杂着一连串的残影迅速躲闪后退，这才堪堪避过了对方挥翅而来的攻击。而打了个空的翅膀则重重的砸在了甲板上，立刻就将坚硬厚实的甲板砸出了一个大洞。
不愧是十级精英的攻击力。
罗德擦了擦头上的冷汗，自己现在才五级，而且没有任何任何装备，要是被这么扫上一下恐怕就连天王老子都救不回来。虽然他也很担心卡特等人，不过幸运的是就目前来看，或许是因为自己给它造成了相当大的伤害的缘故。风蛇领主显然把仇恨都放在自己身上，不幸的就是被一只攻击力如此之高的BOSS盯上，对于非坦克职业来说，压力真的很大……
他的灵魂力量已经下降低到只剩下三分之一，罗德已经感觉有些疲惫了，虽然他在看到风蛇领主时就预料到战斗会很艰苦，但是眼下的压力实在太大，他需要影闪来帮助自己躲避攻击，因为按照他目前的速度，想要躲开风蛇领主的袭击根本就是天方夜谈。但是另外一方面，他也同样需要破碎之刃来造成伤害，以在最短的时间内打倒这个棘手的存在。
不过现在看起来这并不容易。
浮空船正在缓缓的降低高度，但是在风蛇领主的攻击下，却是不时的左右摇摆，宛如惊涛骇浪中的一艘小舟，让人提心掉胆。已经连续有两个佣兵因此被甩了出去，眼见是活不成了。卡特依然在努力的想要驱开风蛇领主，他的双剑在身前舞动，灵活的攻击着风蛇领主的侧面，却是收效不大。如果不是莉洁在后面不时的给这些佣兵施放治愈之光，恐怕他们也没有办法坚持到现在。
必须想个办法，否则的话，还没等浮空船降落，恐怕就要被这只该死的破蛇折腾散架了。
想到这里，罗德咬了咬嘴唇。
风蛇领主的攻击并没有减弱，它身侧的翅膀长长展开，上面边缘部分的两只爪子则是死死的抓在船首的边缘部分。虽然罗德之前的攻击给了它相当大的伤害，但是作为领主级的怪物，它当然不可能因为受这点伤就退走。相反，这只狡猾的风蛇领主似乎察觉到了眼前敌人的弱点所在，两只锐利的爪子死死的抓住浮空船的外壁，用力的摇晃拉扯着手中的猎物。
虽然浮空船的船身并不算脆弱，但是在之前与风蛇群的战斗中却已经是伤痕累累，再加上呼啸的风潮冲击着船身，使其开始有些扭曲变形。甚至甲板上也出现了好几条令人触目惊心的裂缝，发出了让人胆寒的破裂声。
“天啊！！天啊！”
蜷缩在船长室的一角，胖商人混身打颤的盯着外面那条可怕的风蛇领主，因为紧张与恐惧，他的声音都变的有些扭曲了。

“那个该死的理查德！！不要让我遇到他，不然的话我一定会要了他的命！居然给我指这么一条路，他这是谋杀！！”说道这里，胖商人猛然一颤，接着盯上了自己身边的船长。
“还有你！这么可怕的东西，你为什么不早提醒我！？”
船长并没有回应胖商人的怒喝，此刻的他正握紧方向舵，双眼紧盯着前方。同时在内心深处大骂这个该死的混球，自己之前提醒他这个时节走这条航线很有可能会招惹到风蛇群，但是这个家伙还不以为意。现在可好，等死到临头了，他居然怪起自己来了！早知道会是这样，当初自己打死也不该接这趟活儿！
content_en:
Chapter 5 Crisis
The originally violent attack of the wind snakes slowed down, and the deck, which was originally chaotic and full of shouts, shouts, and screams, actually experienced a moment of silence. Everyone looked at the young man with disbelief, not knowing what to say.
At that moment, almost everyone thought that this young man was dead. They had never seen a person who could survive the siege of dozens of wind snakes. Of course, those high-level professionals or shield warriors in full armor might be able to do this. But this young man didn't look very old, and he didn't have any protective equipment except for the white sword in his hand.
But he actually did it.
At this moment, not only the mercenaries, but even Li Jie and Carter couldn't help but look at the young man blankly, their hearts ups and downs.
Who is he?
I don't know if they were frightened by Rhodes' attack, but all the wind snakes that were still desperately attacking the floating ship dispersed and retreated. For a while, except for the howling wind, there was almost no sound on the entire deck. The mercenaries were shocked by Rhodes' performance, but for Rhodes, he didn't care about what he had done. On the contrary, at this moment, he looked at the pile of corpses at his feet and secretly felt that he was in danger.
Although the wind snake is one of the lowest level monsters and is not particularly powerful, it is still a monster that relies on numbers to win. Rhodes' Summoned Swordsman is a single-player profession, but it is not very powerful for large-scale single-player. In fact, the reason why it went so smoothly this time is mainly because the "Star Mark" in his hand has an initial +3 characteristic, which means that when holding this sword, Rhodes' attributes can be increased by three points. The increase of these three points is enough to reduce a monster's danger level from red to green. Therefore, for Rhodes, destroying these wind snakes is not a particularly surprising thing.
But thinking about this, Rhodes was still a little strange. If he were to calculate according to his attributes as a human, then even if he had a "Star Mark", he shouldn't be able to sweep the fallen leaves in the autumn wind and gain such an overwhelming advantage. According to his original estimation, the Broken Blade could at most wipe out the remaining health of these wind snakes, so he had already been prepared to go up and touch up the wounds. But he didn't expect that the power of this Broken Blade move was far beyond his imagination, and it could directly kill these wind snakes?
Aren't your attributes calculated according to human beings?
Thinking of this, Rhodes subconsciously called up his attribute table, but unfortunately, before his race was found out, his attributes were also hidden and could not be queried. Fortunately, this battle allowed him to get 1900 experience points - there was actually experience points to gain, which surprised Rhodes.
Of course, this only lasted two or three seconds for Rhodes. In the eyes of others, he just stared at the pile of corpses at his feet in silence for a moment, and then raised his head again.
It was at this moment that Rhodes discovered the strange silence around him. It was not because of the shock of others, but because of something more dangerous and deadly.
What about the wind snakes?
This thought flashed through Rhode's mind, and then he seemed to remember something, turned around hurriedly, and shouted.
"Everyone, be careful...!"
At this moment, the floating ship suddenly shook.
The violent vibration caused many people to fall directly to the ground, and two unlucky people even slipped and fell without having time to stand firm. At the same time, the deck on the bow of the ship made a crisp crackling sound, and then, a huge snake head poked out from it.
"Everyone, be careful, it's Lord Wind Snake!"
At this time Carter finally appeared, he shouted loudly, and thenThen he drew out the two swords at hand and flew towards the huge wind snake. The other mercenaries also stood up hurriedly at this moment. Although they were already scarred, they still gritted their teeth and followed their leader, trying to attack this behemoth.
However, Rhodes' movements were faster than them all.
He half-crouched down, and lines of system prompts immediately appeared in front of him.
[Experience points 1900/200, can be upgraded, gain 1 skill point, level 2]
[Experience points 1700/400, can be upgraded, gain 2 skill points, level 3]
[Experience points 1300/600, skill points gained 3, level 4]
[Experience points 800/1000, skill points gained 4, level 5]
[Consume 1 skill point to increase Moon Shadow Swordsmanship by 1/3, proficiency E]
[Consume 1 skill point to increase Moon Shadow Swordsmanship by 2/3, proficiency E]
[Consumption of 1 skill point, improves Moon Shadow Swordsmanship by 3/3, proficiency E]
[Consume 1 skill point, improve Moon Shadow Swordsmanship by 1/4, proficiency D——Shadow Flash is unlocked]
Rhodes jumped up.
At that moment, everyone's eyes were blurred, and then they saw the young man standing on the ground turn into a black shadow, cutting through the sky like a sharp blade and rushing forward. Even the huge wind snake lord didn't have time to react. When Rhodes leapt up and came to it, the other party even looked a little confused - it was obvious that it had never encountered a strange situation where prey jumped up and brought it to its mouth.
Rhodes raised his sword, and the brilliance of stardust condensed on the flawless sword body at that moment as if attracted by invisible gravity. Then he aimed at the wind snake lord's eyes as big as copper bells and stabbed them hard.
"Broken Blade!"
Facing the oncoming sword light, the Lord of the Wind Snake's first reaction was to dodge. After continuously improving the Moon Shadow Swordsmanship by four levels of proficiency, the number and power of the Broken Blades suddenly increased by more than one step. Dozens of silver-white light blades erupted from the sword at that moment, circling and shooting forward.
One way, two ways, three ways...
At the beginning, the wind snake lord's hard scales barely resisted the initial sword light blade, but even with his lord-level protection, he only lasted until the twentieth sword light before completely collapsing. The sword light that followed easily tore through the scales and flesh, piercing its body. Although the wind snake lord was huge, Rhodes very smartly chose to break through. Under his control, the light blade did not spread out like before, but concentrated on the opponent's neck, and successfully broke through the opponent's defense.
“————!!”
The Wind Snake Lord let out a sharp hiss, and then fell heavily, but even so, it did not give up the attack. Although the left neck part had become bloody, the Night Crow Lord suddenly raised his head, stared at Rhodes, and then suddenly opened his mouth.
Rhodes' figure flickered, and once again turned into a phantom and retreated quickly. As he retreated, the extremely smelly venom shot straight up, barely grazing the remnant of Rhodes, and sprayed onto the mast behind. Soon, under the corrosion of the venom, the originally strong and hard mast completely melted in just a few seconds, and then collapsed.
BOSS is BOSS after all.
According to Rhodes' experience in the game, the average level of the wind snake is around level three, and its leader is generally at level ten. The BOSS in front of him should not exceed level ten at most. Although in terms of level, it is not difficult to defeat this BOSS with the help of Carter and mercenaries, but after the sword just now, Rhodes realized that this was probably not an ordinary lord-level monster, but an elite.After all, if it were just an ordinary lord monster, then Rhode's sword just now would be enough to cut off its wings. But in fact, although Rhodes tried his best, he still only left a scar that was deep enough to show the bone, which is very clear about the problem.
"Go and attack its wings, stay as far away from its mouth as possible! Go to its side and attack!"
While Rhodes was commanding Carter and other mercenaries, he was entangled with the Wind Serpent Lord. Although as a Summoning Swordsman, he was not the main MT player, it seemed that no one else had ever fought against the Wind Serpent Lord. In the game, if the group was wiped out due to lack of experience, they could start over, but Rhodes was not willing to take this risk here - the wound on his left chest that had healed before was now in burning pain, and seemed to have opened again. If he died due to group destruction here, it would be a joke that he couldn't even cry about. And although he is only level 5 now, for Rhodes, as long as the opponent's level does not exceed level 15, he is confident to fight. After all, in the Dragon Soul Continent, there are three professions that are famous for leapfrogging monsters, the mage, the ranger, and the last one is the summoned swordsman. Mages are famous for their unpredictable spells, while rangers are powerful for their ultra-long-distance "kite flying". As for summoning swordsmen, they simply rely on more people to defeat less people. For these three professions, even if the level difference exceeds five levels, it is as easy as eating and drinking for them. Non-elite BOSS level beings up to ten levels can do whatever they want.
Even so, these three professions also have their own shortcomings - without magic power, the mage is no different from a target. Even a group of low-level goblins can beat him to death. It is a complete tragedy for the ranger to be approached by others. Summoning swordsmen is too random, and the operation is so complicated that there is almost no template to follow. This is also the reason why these three professions have not reached the point of surging in the game. And this is also closer to the realistic setting of Dragon Soul Continent - either take a gamble and not take the ordinary path, or move forward slowly and steadily, players can decide their own destiny and future at will.
The current Wind Snake Lord is a level 10 elite BOSS. However, due to the star mark bonus he holds in his hand, its defense power is only at level six or seven at most. Therefore, in terms of defense, Rhodes does not have to worry about insufficient damage, but in terms of attack...
"Phew!!"
Fierce winds rose from the ground.
Rhodes' figure suddenly swayed, followed by a series of afterimages, and he quickly dodged and retreated. Only then did he barely avoid the opponent's attack with wings. The empty wings hit the deck hard, immediately punching a big hole in the hard and thick deck.
It is worthy of the attack power of a level 10 elite.
Rhodes wiped the cold sweat from his head. He was only at level 5 now, and he didn't have any equipment. If he was attacked like this, even the King of Heaven might not be able to save him. Although he is also worried about Carter and others, luckily for now, it may be because he has caused considerable damage to it. Lord Wind Snake obviously puts all his hatred on himself. Unfortunately, he is targeted by a BOSS with such a high attack power. For non-tank professions, the pressure is really great...
His soul power had dropped to only one-third, and Rhodes was already feeling a little tired. Although he had expected the battle to be difficult when he saw the Wind Serpent Lord, the pressure at the moment was too great. He needed Shadow Flash to help him avoid the attack, because at his current speed, it was impossible to avoid the Wind Serpent Lord's attack. But on the other hand, he also needs the Broken Blade to cause damage in order to defeat this troublesome existence in the shortest possible time.
But now it looks like it won't be easy.
The float ship is slowly descendingIt was at a low height, but under the attack of Lord Wind Serpent, it swayed from time to time, like a small boat in the stormy sea, which made people nervous. Two mercenaries have been thrown out in succession because of this, and they are dying to survive. Carter was still trying hard to drive away the Wind Serpent Lord. His swords were dancing in front of him, attacking the side of the Wind Serpent Lord flexibly, but with little effect. If Li Jie hadn't cast healing light on these mercenaries from time to time, they probably wouldn't have been able to persist until now.
We must find a way, otherwise, before the floating ship lands, I'm afraid it will be torn apart by this damn broken snake.
Thinking of this, Rhodes bit his lip.
The wind snake lord's attack did not weaken. The wings on its side spread out long, and the two claws on the upper edge were tightly grasping the edge of the bow. Although Rhodes' previous attack caused considerable damage to it, as a lord-level monster, it is certainly impossible for it to retreat just because of this injury. On the contrary, this cunning wind snake lord seemed to be aware of the weakness of the enemy in front of him. His two sharp claws firmly grasped the outer wall of the floating ship, shaking hard and pulling the prey in his hands.
Although the hull of the floating ship is not fragile, it has been scarred in the previous battle with the wind snakes. In addition, the roaring wind and waves hit the hull, causing it to begin to twist and deform. There were even several shocking cracks on the deck, making frightening cracking sounds.
"Oh my God! Oh my God!"
Huddled in a corner of the captain's cabin, the fat businessman trembled and stared at the terrifying wind snake lord outside. His voice became a little distorted due to nervousness and fear.
"That damn Richard!! Don't let me meet him, otherwise I will definitely kill him! He actually pointed me such a way, this is murder!!" After saying this, the fat businessman shuddered suddenly, and then stared at the captain beside him.
"And you! Why didn't you warn me about such a terrifying thing!?"
The captain did not respond to the fat businessman's angry shout. At this moment, he was holding the rudder tightly and staring straight ahead. At the same time, he cursed this damn bastard deep in his heart. He had reminded him before that taking this route at this time of year would probably provoke the wind snakes, but this guy didn't take it seriously yet. Well, now, when death is imminent, he actually blames himself! If I had known this would be the case, I shouldn't have taken this job even if I was beaten to death!
